_source: app.notion.com ComCom > Projects, 'on-going projects' table view, 2026-08-06. Read-only per docs/notion-golden-set.md §3: horizontal wheel scrolling to paint the Evaluation/Team/Status columns, computed styles read off the painted chips, and ONE Evaluation cell clicked to open its option list (measured, then Escape — no option was picked). Numbers are px.
_why: The chip is not one shape. A select/multi-select value is a 4px-radius chip; a status value is a 10px pill with a dot. We drew everything as the pill, because the only thing measured before was the Status menu.

select._of: Evaluation (select) and Team (multi_select), identical in a cell and in the option list

status._of: Status (status) in a cell — matches e2e/fixtures/notion-status-dropdown.json

cell._of: a multi_select cell holding two chips (Team)

colors._note: Notion paints translucent overlays, hence the alpha. Sampled where each was on screen: red/purple/yellow/green/brown/blue from the Evaluation option list, orange/pink from Team cells, gray from the Status menu fixture.

colorsDark._source: app.notion.com Projects 'All Projects' table, 2026-09-09, dark theme via CDP Emulation.setEmulatedMedia(prefers-color-scheme: dark) on a dedicated tab (the workspace setting stays untouched, other tabs stay light). Chip bg/text read off Evaluation/Status cells, the Status property editor's option rows, and the option submenu's colour list (18px swatch fill = chip bg, swatch color = chip text, label names the key). Dots read off the five status colours on screen and were identical to light; brown/orange/purple/pink dots are ASSUMED unchanged (no status option carries them) — not measured.
colorsDark._why: The chip carried light literals only; in dark mode that was rgb(73,72,70) text on a 0.11 dark overlay over rgb(25,25,25) — unreadable. Notion flips both the overlay (bright, higher alpha) and the label (near-white tints).

default.seenAs: Not started (chip paints like gray; swatch is its own)

swatchLight._of: the property editor's colour menu in the light theme (scratchpad/status-edit-capture/option-submenu-nodes.json, 2026-08-10): 18×18 radius-4, fill = chip bg, plus a 1px inset ring of the same colour; only 기본 differs — fill rgba(42, 28, 0, 0.07), ring rgba(28, 19, 1, 0.11)

_mismatch: Our copy of the Evaluation option 'Need Improvement' is stored as color 'orange', but the original paints it brown (rgba(127,51,0,.157)); the original's actual orange is rgba(196,88,0,.204), seen on Team. The option's stored colour came in with the import, so the fix belongs there, not in the chip.
